scope: 31 paired FuXi-S2S/ERPAS JJAS starts in 2023-2024, verified independently against IMD and IMERG Final V07B
case_pairing: ERPAS Wednesday with preceding-Monday FuXi; four identical Thursday-Wednesday seven-day windows
aggregation: arithmetic mean of case-wise area-weighted spatial ACC; IQR is descriptive

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap within each year
bootstrap.purpose: robustness supplement only; no headline significance claim

imd.feb29_rule: mean of Feb-28 and Mar-01 climatology fields

source_attrs.title: IMERG Final V07B daily precipitation, India pilot subset
source_attrs.rate_to_accumulation: numeric value unchanged because every source interval is exactly one day
source_attrs.period_convention: period_start inclusive, period_end exclusive; exact UTC day

attrs.title: IMERG Final V07B 2001-2022 fixed daily climatology for India S2S verification
attrs.remapping: conservative spherical overlap to fixed IMD-derived India support

excluded_missing_pairs.reason: matched preceding-Monday strict-00Z FuXi file missing
